model: symmetric four-site jump (+phi, -phi, 180-phi, 180+phi), equal populations, one tensor diagonal in each conformer's acute-bisector frame (shared Szz, Delta)
estimand: jump-model phi (NOT the thesis AP-DPD phi_m; a different quantity)
frame: bisector frame of datasets/biphenyl-synthetic/generate.py: z along the inter-ring axis (ring A at z < 0), x bisects the two ring planes, y = z × x; the tensor is diagonal there with free Szz and Delta = Sxx − Syy
geometry_note: idealised regular rings, NOT the optimised geometry used in the thesis
N_rule: 12 unique couplings per temperature; p_free = 3; nu = 9

configurations.unweighted: ordinary least squares (no error model): report phi, Szz, Delta, RMS, predictions; intervals not supported
configurations.weighted: spectral sigma as a Gaussian likelihood: report the fit AND the inadequacy flag

optimum_convention: refined bounded optimum: best point of the grid 0:0.5:90 deg, refined by bounded 1-D minimisation of the VarPro profile objective over the neighbouring grid cells (xatol 1e-11 deg); the grid point itself is NOT the expected value

sanity_bounds_vs_check_fit_out.note: rounded prototype values are sanity bounds only

tolerances.note: plan v0.6 §8 M1; objective, interval and stderr tolerances added at the M0 freeze

gates.unweighted: reproduce phi, Szz, Delta, RMS and the prediction vector within the regression tolerances
gates.weighted: reproduce the fit within the regression tolerances and report adequate == false
gates.e_jump: explicit four-conformer averaging equals the relabelling shortcut (atol 1e-9 Hz)
